#!/bin/bash

# Health check script to verify if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding
# Also reports API credential status to monitoring dashboard

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local timeout=5

    # Use curl to check if the port responds
    if curl --output /dev/null --silent --head --fail --max-time $timeout http://localhost:$port; then
        echo "Port $port: UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Port $port: DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Read .env.test file and convert to JSON
if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
    echo "Error: .env.test file not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Function to convert .env file to JSON using pure bash
convert_env_to_json() {
    local json="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Remove any leading/trailing whitespace from value
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
        
        # Add comma if not the first entry
        if [[ "$first" == "true" ]]; then
            first=false
        else
            json+=","
        fi
        
        # Add key-value pair to JSON
        json+="\"$key\": \"$value\""
    done < .env.test
    
    json+="}"
    echo "$json"
}

# Convert .env.test to JSON format
env_json=$(convert_env_to_json)

# Check if parsing failed
if [[ -z "$env_json" ]]; then
    echo "Error: Failed to parse .env.test file"
    exit 1
fi

# Store port status for use in both display and API report
port_3000_up=$(check_port 3000 > /dev/null && echo true || echo false)
port_8000_up=$(check_port 8080 > /dev/null && echo true || echo false)

# Display port status
check_port 3000
check_port 8080

# Send POST request to monitoring dashboard
echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
curl --silent --fail -X POST http://localhost:47301/api/health-report \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"service_status\": {\"port_3000\": $port_3000_up, \"port_8080\": $port_8000_up}, \"credentials\": $env_json}"

if [[ "$?" -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "Health report successfully sent to monitoring dashboard"
else
    echo "Failed to send health report to monitoring dashboard"
    exit 1
fi
